summary: Mint Inc Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a board-approved 1-for-10 reverse stock split effective May 6, 2026, to regain Nasdaq compliance with a $1.00 minimum bid price, required by June 17, 2026. No shareholder approval was needed. Outstanding shares will reduce from 20,512,500 to about 2,051,250. Fractional shares rounded up. Options and warrants adjusted accordingly. This is a routine corporate action by the issuer, not a special situation. Watch for Nasdaq compliance monitoring and potential delisting appeal if the bid-price condition is not met within the extension period.
